title: GPS-RATIONAL-LOGELASTIC: complete rational source law with a strict cube-root-copy refinement

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ, n=ceil(log2N), the ONE GPS-RATIONAL-LOGELASTIC program in proof.md with selected fixed p=3,q=1,beta=1/8,eta=1,gamma=-15/16 recovers the entire secret from independent ideal copies with unconditional probability at least1-2^-8. For n<2^9216 it executes exhaustive shift testing; otherwise v is the least integer with v^3>=n^2, ell=ceil(log2n), h is the least integer with h^8>=ell, b=ceil(v*(4ell+6h-48)/3), m=ceil((n-1)/b), with top-down widths r_i=b_i+1, zero-width ownership shortcuts and every source/decoder/precision/acquisition/fallback quantity recomputed. Jointly on EVERY branch including failed work, discarded copies, wrong labels, both aborts, initialization and cleanup, time T is O(2^((2/3)n^(2/3)*log2n+n^(2/3)*(log2n)^(1/8))) with exact growth index2/3. All constants are absolute and all source/arithmetic/circuit-generation/address/measurement/reset/cleanup charges are paid jointly with both spaces, source cap, unconditional success and clean fraction0 for this same configuration.

For the same GPS-RATIONAL-LOGELASTIC algorithm and complete parameter rule in proof.md, the proved malformed-sample fractional guarantee is epsilon(n)=0: all Q acquired source copies are independent ideal coset states. Under this promise, for every N >= 2 and every s in Z/NZ, unconditional full-secret recovery succeeds with probability at least 1-2^-8 > 3/4 jointly with all four every-branch resource bounds. No positive corruption tolerance is asserted, and this is not a proof that greater tolerance is impossible.

structured.error_model: Malformed fraction among acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
